items.title: Rough waves disrupt Ennore Expressway in Chennai as Cyclone Arnab hits AP
items.summary: Rough waves driven by Cyclone Arnab surged over the shoreline and onto the Ennore Expressway in north Chennai on the evening of October 27, disrupting traffic, pushing vehicles off the road and sweeping away roadside stalls. The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has now closed the affected stretch of the Ennore Expressway. Videos circulating on social media showed cars, autorickshaws and two-wheelers being drenched by waves, while some smaller vehicles were pushed by the water’s force. The Ennore Expressway connects Ennore with Kasimedu harbour and is used by trucks travelling to the port as well as residents of Kasimedu, Tollgate, Thiruvottiyur and Ennore. Police diverted traffic to prevent accidents. According to Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC), vehicles travelling from Ramakrishna Nagar to Annai Sivagami Nagar were directed via Ernavur Bridge, Murugar Kovil Road and Kathivakkam Beach. Vehicles from Thazhakuppam and Ennore were diverted via Kathivakkam Bridge and Murugar Kovil Road.
